evidence: Metal /H9252-diketonate complexes, tris /H208492,2,6,6tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato/H20850M /H20849III/H20850, denoted as M/H20849TMHD/H208503 /H20849M = Y or Er /H20850, were chosen as the metal precursors. These precursors are fairly bulky, with the center trivalent metal ion coordinated by three negatively charged /H9252-diketonate ligands, each of which is about 1 nm in size. 9 To minimize cross contamination, a three-array precursor doser was used to deliver the precursor vapors independently into the reactor without a carrier gas. Reactive O radicals were chosen as the oxidant, since metal /H9252-diketonate complexes are fairly stable against oxidation. 3,10 The O radicals were generated from a coaxial waveguide microwave source, operating at 20 W with an O 2 feed gas flow rate of 1 SCCM (SCCM denotes cubic centimeter per minute at STP).
